agreement.name: Bachelor of Science Major in Mathematics

notes.content: Bachelor of Science Major in Mathematics
Students must complete a minimum of 120 units with a Pacific cumulative and major/program grade point average of 2.0 in order to earn the Bachelor of Science degree with a major in mathematics.
